name: Stargazer Initiate

name: Astral Moth

name: Star Chart
cardText: Draw 2 cards.
flavorText: Two cards. No strings. No tricks. Just pure, uncut VALUE injected directly into your hand.

name: Nebula Sprite

name: Astral Navigator
cardText: SCRY (3).
flavorText: Knows exactly what's coming next. Still gasps dramatically. Every. Single. Time.

name: Prophecy Keeper

flavorText: Predicts cheap cards. Draws cheap cards. She's a living coupon book and she's PROUD of it.

name: Supernova Shard
cardText: Deal 3 damage. SCRY (2). If the top card is a spell, deal 3 more damage.
flavorText: Peek. Boom. Maybe double boom. The suspense is half the fun. The damage is the other half.

name: Astral Archive
cardText: Draw 3 cards. Put 1 card from your hand on top of your deck.
flavorText: Take three. Return one. The galaxy's most generous library. Zero late fees. Infinite power.

name: Cosmic Resonance
cardText: SCRY (4). Draw 2 cards.
flavorText: Arrange FOUR. Draw TWO. Your deck just became a loaded weapon with a hair trigger.

name: Starfall Sentinel
cardText: SWIFT. SCRY (1).
flavorText: Hits first. Peeks second. Leaves third. A cosmic hit-and-run artist.

name: Fate Weaver
cardText: DEPLOY: SCRY (3). Draw the top card. It costs (2) less this turn.
flavorText: Sees your best card. Yoinks it. Slaps a discount sticker on it. Absolute legend.

name: Celestial Observer
cardText: Whenever you draw a card, deal 1 damage to a random enemy.
flavorText: Draws hurt. Being watched by this thing hurts MORE. Every card is a tiny psychic bullet.

name: Star Storm
cardText: Deal 4 damage. SCRY (3).
flavorText: Four damage NOW. Three perfectly arranged cards for LATER. The present AND future hate your opponent.

name: Divination

flavorText: Choose your destiny. From five options. Like a cosmic buffet but everything's a weapon.

name: Astral Titan
cardText: SCRY (3). DEPLOY: Draw the top 2 cards of your deck.
flavorText: Arranges three. Draws two. Asks for nothing. The math checks out gloriously.

name: Cosmic Bombardment
cardText: Deal 2 damage to all enemies. Draw a card for each enemy minion damaged.
flavorText: Hurts them. Rewards you. Somehow this is fair because the stars said so.

cardText: DEPLOY: Look at your opponent's hand. SCRY (5).
flavorText: Sees THEIR cards. Arranges YOURS. That's not cheating. That's astronomy.

name: Knowledge is Power
cardText: Draw cards until you have 8 in hand.
flavorText: Hand empty? Full refill. Hand almost full? Still draws one. Never disappointed. Never empty.

name: Galaxy Drifter
cardText: DEPLOY: Draw 3 cards. SCRY (3).
flavorText: Six stats. Six cards touched. Six reasons your opponent just sighed out loud.

name: Starfire
cardText: Deal damage equal to the number of cards in your hand.

name: Celestial Arbiter
cardText: DEPLOY: Draw 2 cards. Your cards cost (1) less until end of turn.
flavorText: Draws AND discounts. The cosmic equivalent of a Black Friday doorbuster.

name: Cosmic Alignment
cardText: SCRY (10). Draw 3 cards. They cost (3) less.
flavorText: See the ENTIRE future. Cherry-pick the best timeline. Discount it. This is why people fear astronomers.

name: Astral Familiar
cardText: Whenever you SCRY, gain +1/+1.
flavorText: Gets bigger every time you peek at destiny. Curiosity didn't kill this cat. It made it a 9/10.

name: Observatory
cardText: Start of Turn: SCRY (2).
flavorText: Free future-peeking. Every. Single. Turn. It's like having a subscription to tomorrow.

cardText: SCRY (5). Draw the top card. If it's a Legendary, it costs (0).
flavorText: Arrange five. Draw one. If you hit a Legendary? It's FREE, baby. Destiny rewards the bold.

name: Oracle of Celestara
cardText: Whenever you SCRY, draw a card.
flavorText: Every peek at the future comes with a present. Literally. She wraps them and everything.

name: Cosmic Librarian
cardText: Your card draw effects draw 1 additional card.
flavorText: Overdue fees: zero. Bonus cards: unlimited. She's been banned from four dimensions for being too generous.

name: Stellar Nexus
cardText: Whenever you draw a card, SCRY (1). Cards drawn by SCRY effects cost (1) less.
flavorText: Draw triggers SCRY. SCRY triggers draw. It's not a loop, it's a LIFESTYLE.

name: Constellation Strike
cardText: Deal 1 damage to a random enemy for each card you've drawn this turn. SCRY (3).
flavorText: Drew seven cards? That's seven damage. Knowledge IS power. LITERALLY.

name: Mind Palace
cardText: Draw 4 cards. Put 2 back on top of your deck in any order.
flavorText: Take four. Return two. Your brain is a warehouse and it just got a new shipment.

name: Galactic Sage
cardText: DEPLOY: SCRY (5). You may play the top card of your deck for free.
flavorText: Peeks at five. Plays one. Doesn't pay. She's been dodging cosmic invoices for centuries.

name: Fatespinner
cardText: Whenever you draw a card, add a random Astromancer spell to your hand. It costs (1).
flavorText: Draws cards. Makes spells. Spells draw cards. She hasn't slept in four star-cycles and she's THRIVING.

name: Cosmic Overflow
cardText: Draw 5 cards. For each card drawn that exceeds your hand limit, deal 3 damage to the enemy Hero.
flavorText: Hand overstuffed? The excess becomes PAIN. Your opponent's pain. Your joy. Same thing.

name: Dimensional Echo
cardText: The next card you draw this turn is copied 3 times.
flavorText: Draw one. Get four. It's not cheating if the universe does it for you.

name: Star Architect
cardText: DEPLOY: Rearrange the top 8 cards of your deck. Draw 2.
flavorText: Doesn't just see the future. BUILDS it. With blueprints. And very dramatic hand gestures.

name: Nebula Collapse
cardText: Destroy an enemy minion. Draw cards equal to its Attack. (Max 5.)
flavorText: Kill it. Study the corpse. Draw EVERYTHING it knew. Morbid? Yes. Effective? Extremely.

name: Stellar Beacon

flavorText: Finds the good stuff. Buries the garbage. Marie Kondo of the cosmos.

name: Cosmic Cascade
cardText: Draw a card. If it costs (3) or less, cast this again. (Repeatable.)
flavorText: Draw. Cheap? Draw AGAIN. Keeps going until you hit something expensive. It's a slot machine made of stars.

name: Astral Sanctum
cardText: Your SCRY effects look at 2 additional cards. Cards you draw cost (1) less.

name: Starchild Prodigy
cardText: After you draw 3 cards in a single turn, gain +3/+3 and BARRIER.

name: Graviton Surge

cardText: SWIFT. DEPLOY: SCRY (3). If the top card costs (2) or less, draw it.

cardText: DEPLOY: Draw a card from the BOTTOM of your deck. SCRY (2).
flavorText: Everyone looks at the top. She digs from the bottom. Contrarian? Genius? Both.

flavorText: Draws fuel. Counts spells. Unleashes apocalyptic scholarship.

cardText: Whenever you SCRY, set the top card's cost to (0). Whenever you draw a card, SCRY (1).

cardText: Look at the top 8 cards of your deck. Play up to 2 of them for free. Shuffle the rest back.
flavorText: Eight possibilities. Two freebies. The other six go back to the future where they'll be someone else's problem.

cardText: GUARDIAN. Attack equals the number of cards in your hand. Whenever you draw a card, gain +0/+1.
flavorText: Hits as hard as you're holding. Grows every time you draw. Full hand = full send. Empty hand = she takes a nap.

name: CELESTIAL ORACLE
cardText: DEPLOY: SCRY (5). Whenever you draw a card, play the top card of your deck for free if it costs (4) or less.

cardText: SCRY (15). Draw 5 cards. They cost (0) this turn. For the rest of the game, you draw an extra card per turn.
